    Irreducible maps #

    A map is irreducible when it is neither a split monomorphism nor a split epimorphism and every factorization has a split mono first factor or a split epi second factor (IsIrr). An irreducible map into the target of a right almost split map factors through it by a split mono (IsIrr.factor_rightAS), and dually (IsIrr.factor_leftAS). The left map of an exact sequence 0 → X → E → Z → 0 with left almost split f and Z local is irreducible (isIrr_of_leftAS).
